matcher_subsumption_check.description: Verify engine at d_max=2 solves matcher-solved pairs. Done with safe_search; the matcher's variable-disjoint catches are not in safe_search's reach by construction.
matcher_subsumption_check.interpretation: Of 49,586 matcher proofs: 19,576 (39.5%) have within-ceiling E1 and are subsumed by engine at d_max=2. 30,010 (60.5%) have variable-disjoint E1 — matcher catches them via Birkhoff substitution-instance reasoning; engine cannot recover them via rewriting. Matcher variable-disjoint contribution to combined coverage: 30,010 / 8,173,585 = 0.367% of GT TRUE. Phase 5 union must keep matcher's variable-disjoint pairs as a separate union element.

rewrite_chain_validation.description: Run safe_search at d_max=6 over the full rewrite-chain corpus. Compare to the original rewrite-chain study's 83% (which used the unsafe engine).
rewrite_chain_validation.interpretation: Unsafe engine's 83% in the rewrite-chain study was substantially driven by rule-var leakage. Safe engine: 20.79% overall, 47.16% of within-ceiling subset. Depth sweep in Phase 3 will quantify how much d_max=8 lifts this.
